interpretation.correction_ratio: A value nearer 1 means the student applies a correction magnitude nearer SCUNet.
interpretation.seam_gradient_ratio: A value nearer 1 is neutral; raw deltas are not intrinsically better or worse.
interpretation.teacher_agreement: Higher PSNR/SSIM means closer to SCUNet, not necessarily closer to a clean target.

purpose: existing-output comparison; no inference and no metric recomputation from pixels
